note: Vault definitions for the Sprint-12 soak drills. Deliberately DIFFERENT from the Sprint-9 smoke vault in basket, caps, fees and governance, so that drill 1's leaderboard aggregation is proving real cross-vault aggregation rather than summing two identical rows.
agentDepositNote: Drill 5: the agent deposits exactly the smoke vault minDepositUsdc (1.00 USDC), read from chain. The throwaway holds 3.00, leaving margin for gas-adjacent retries without over-committing a key that exists only for this drill.

smokeVault.note: The Sprint-9 vault. Basket [WETH, LINK]. Fully exited at the end of Sprint-9 (0 shares, 0 NAV), so drills 2 and 5 must re-deposit into it. Host for drill 2 (sub-vault) and drill 5 (agent execute mode).

vaultB.label: soak-B
vaultB.note: Drill 1's second vault and drill 3's Mode-F host. Basket is LINK-ONLY -- a strict subset of the smoke vault's basket, which makes it a different risk profile for the leaderboard AND keeps it eligible to be a child of the smoke vault should we need a second sub-vault case. Governance runs a 50% quorum against the smoke vault's 25% floor.

childVault.label: soak-child
childVault.note: Drill 2's sub-vault, created under the smoke vault. Basket [WETH] is a strict subset of the parent's [WETH, LINK] -- VaultFactory.createChildVault enforces the subset rule and the same USDC. exitFeeMaxBps must keep the SV-4 stacked ceiling under the registry cap: parent 50 + child 25 = 75 bps.
childVault.amountsNote: Drill 2 deposits 4 USDC into the PARENT and allocates 2 of it into the child, leaving 2 idle. Keeping some idle is deliberate: it proves the parent NAV conservation check is reading a real split rather than a total transfer, and it leaves room for the redeem round trip.
childVault.govNote: SV-6 / _requireParentQuorumFloor: a child's quorum may not sit below its parent's. Parent runs 2500, child runs 5000, so the floor is satisfied with margin.

parentDeposit.note: Into the smoke vault, funding drill 2's allocation into the child (4 USDC) with idle USDC left over so the parent's own NAV stays non-zero and look-through arithmetic has two non-trivial terms to check.

budget.note: 13 of the creator's 20 USDC: 5 into vault B (drills 1+3) and 8 into the smoke vault (drill 2). 7 USDC held in reserve so a stranded drill can be re-run without a faucet round trip.
